quote.author: Adam Aaronson
quote.text:
Joel Embiid:  9:05, +7

Adem Bona: 7:05, -10

That was a particularly brutal stint for Bona, having a really rough start to his third NBA season. I would be ready to turn to Jabari Walker (I would have given Walker the first crack at backup center minutes anyways).

items.title: Nick Nurse on Dean Wade: “It’s a matchup game tonight for him.” Pointed out how much smaller New York’s bench is than Cleveland’s and said “Dean will be able to match those guys,” while also indicating this could be a good matchup for Jabari Walker.
items.author: Adam Aaronson
items.body_excerpt:
Nick Nurse on Dean Wade: “It’s a matchup game tonight for him.” Pointed out how much smaller New York’s bench is than Cleveland’s and said “Dean will be able to match those guys,” while also indicating this could be a good matchup for Jabari Walker.

Wade remains questionable.

items.title: Philly's lack of healthy size showing up early. Jordan Clarkson turned the corner on that dribble handoff with Andre Drummond, saw Jabari Walker backtracking in the paint, and went right at him for the layup. Not much resistance with Embiid out of the game.
